job.title: Infinite-LLM: Efficient LLM Service for Long Context with DistAttention and Distributed KVCache
job.selection_reason: attention layerを他の推論処理から分離し、distributed KV cacheとpooled GPU memoryで長contextをelasticに処理。32 A100で1.35-3.4x throughput改善、最大2000K context評価を報告し、attention disaggregation lineageの重要な未収録候補。
